<style>
#node-title, .panels-node-title h3::before { visibility: hidden }
.panel-primary > .panel-heading.panels-node-title { display: none; }
#session-notes-open-modal-button { color: white }

.masthead #logo { text-align: center; float:none; } /* this centers the main logo */
#logo img { height: 75px; } /* this makes the main logo a little smaller */


.panel-reference .panel-heading
{
    background-color: royalblue;
    color: white;
    font-weight:bold;
}
.panel-instructions .panel-heading
{
    background-color: goldenrod;
    color: white;
    font-weight:bold;
}
.panel-script .panel-heading
{
    background-color: slateblue;
    color: white;
    font-weight:bold;
}
.panel-insurance .panel-heading
{
    background-color: #f54a4a;
    color: white;
    font-weight:bold;
}
.panel-script .panel-body
{
    font-size:1.5em;
}
.panel-actions .panel-heading
{
    background-color: mediumseagreen;
    color: white;
    font-weight: bold;
}
.panel-reference .panel-heading .fa,
.panel-instructions .panel-heading .fa,
.panel-script .panel-heading .fa,
.panel-actions .panel-heading .fa,
.panel-insurance .panel-heading .fa
{
    font-size: 1.5em;
    padding: 0px 15px;
}.panel.panel-horizontal
{
    display:table;
    width:100%;
    padding: 0px;
}
.panel.panel-horizontal > .panel-heading, 
.panel.panel-horizontal > .panel-body, 
.panel.panel-horizontal > .panel-footer
{
    display:table-cell;
    padding: .6em .9em;
}
.panel.panel-horizontal > .panel-heading, 
.panel.panel-horizontal > .panel-footer
{
    width: 60px;
    border:0;
    vertical-align: middle;
}
.panel.panel-horizontal > .panel-heading
{
    border-top-right-radius: 0;
    border-bottom-left-radius: 4px;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 12px;
}
.panel.panel-horizontal > .panel-heading > i.fa
{
    font-size: xx-large;
    display: block;
}
.panel.panel-horizontal > .panel-footer
{
    border-top-left-radius: 0;
    border-bottom-right-radius: 4px;
}
.panel.panel-horizontal > .panel-body
{
    font-size: 1.2em;    
}
.panel.panel-horizontal.panel-reference > .panel-body
{
    background-color: #d9e1fa;    
}
.panel.panel-horizontal.panel-instructions > .panel-body
{
    background-color: #fff1ce;
}
.panel.panel-horizontal.panel-instructions > .panel-heading
{
    background-color: goldenrod;
}
.panel.panel-horizontal.panel-instructions > .panel-body
{
    background-color: #fddfdf;
}
.panel.panel-horizontal.panel-instructions > .panel-heading
{
    background-color: #f54a4a;
}
.panel.panel-horizontal.panel-script> .panel-body
{
    font-size: 1.7em;    
}
.panel.panel-horizontal.panel-script > .panel-heading
{
    background-color: slateblue;
}
.panel.panel-horizontal.panel-actions> .panel-body
{
    background-color: #eafef3;    
}
.panel.panel-horizontal > .panel-heading .fa
{
    padding: 0px;
}

#general_inquiry_provider_table  th
{
    vertical-align: middle;
}
span.pronunciation
{
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: .8em;
}

</style>
